backup.title.description: Settings page under General: export and import of settings and favorites

backup.export.description: Settings row: save settings and favorites to the backup file on this TV

backup.import.description: Settings row: restore settings and favorites from the backup file on this TV

backup.import_question.description: Settings page title: confirm that an import replaces the current settings and favorites

backup.exported.description: Toast: the backup file was written

backup.export_failed.description: Toast: the backup file could not be written

backup.imported.description: Toast: settings and favorites were restored from the backup file

backup.none.description: Toast: there is no backup file to import

backup.newer.value: The backup is from a newer version of the app
backup.newer.description: Toast: the backup file was written by a newer app version and is not read

backup.invalid.value: The backup file is not valid
backup.invalid.description: Toast: the backup file is damaged or holds a value the app does not accept; nothing was changed
